content.text: I added the `±` and `%` keys; `%` also works from the keyboard. Both edit the typed number as text, so the value never picks up float noise. That keeps the "value is never rounded" rule, and you can keep typing after either key (`5 ± 3` shows `-53`). My check file, `check/sign-percent.cjs`, passes. After a result, both keys act on that result. Right after an operator, both start a new number from 0. I rejected putting `%` results through float division and showing them as typed text, because `1.1 %` would show `0.011000000000000001`. I also rearranged the key grid to AC ± % ÷ on top, with × − + down the right column and `0 . =` on the bottom row.
